# OpenCode Mobile

> OpenCode Mobile is an unofficial, self-hosted mobile, tablet, and web client for the OpenCode AI coding agent. It connects directly to your development workstation with 1-command setup, terminal ANSI QR pairing, a universal model selector (DeepSeek, Claude 3.7, Gemini 4 Argon, OpenAI, Ollama), a Claude-inspired 120fps fluid UI, and zero telemetry.

## Quickstart (1-Command Install)

### Linux & macOS
```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Aetherdz/opencode-mobile-dist/main/install.sh | bash
```

### Windows (PowerShell)
```powershell
$h = "3a493282e252468ed96012cd0019f5252314bfb5c7b810be34476602616a14aa"
irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Aetherdz/opencode-mobile-dist/7c4ec38b7de7d87e88d7f215721a11bc338e128f/install.ps1 -OutFile install.ps1
if ((Get-FileHash .\install.ps1 -Algorithm SHA256).Hash -ne $h) { throw "checksum mismatch" }
.\install.ps1 -Command install -WorkDir "$env:USERPROFILE\projects"
```

After installation, run `opencode-mobile` on your host machine to output an ANSI QR code in your terminal, then scan it with the mobile app for instant auto-connection.

## Releases & Downloads

- [Android APK v1.0.0-beta.10](https://github.com/Aetherdz/opencode-mobile/releases/download/v1.0.0-beta.10/opencode-mobile-1.0.0-beta.10.apk): Release-signed arm64-v8a APK for Android 7.0+.
- [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/Aetherdz/opencode-mobile/releases): All tagged releases, release notes, and SHA256 checksums.
- [Source Code](https://github.com/Aetherdz/opencode-mobile): Full source for Expo mobile client, Fastify bridge, and deployment scripts.

## Core Capabilities

1. **Universal Model Selector**: Switch seamlessly between any model configured in OpenCode, including Gemini 4 Argon, DeepSeek V3/R1, Claude 3.7 Sonnet, OpenAI GPT-4o, and local Ollama models directly in the chat composer.
2. **Dual-Transport Streaming**: High-frequency primary WebSocket connection (`/ws`) delivering sub-50ms message latency, heartbeat keepalive, and automatic fallback to Server-Sent Events (SSE).
3. **120fps Fluid Mobile UI**: Ergonomics inspired by Claude mobile with native spring physics (`cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)`), tactile press dynamics, high-contrast dark and light themes, and smooth sheet transitions.
4. **Interactive Tool Approvals**: Review command executions, file writes, and web fetches with collapsible syntax-highlighted diffs and safety confirmations.
5. **Attachments & Camera**: Upload photos, screenshots, and source documents directly into active sessions with strict MIME and magic-byte validation.
6. **Zero Telemetry & Local Isolation**: Zero tracking libraries, no Firebase analytics, no external relays. The bridge binds strictly to loopback (`127.0.0.1:8787`) with constant-time token validation and workspace confinement (`ALLOWED_WORKDIRS`).
7. **Four Languages**: Native internationalization in English, Arabic (with full right-to-left layout), French, and Spanish.
